description.zh-CN: 突出材质、做工或功能细节的近景图；保留商品的 Logo、文字和形状，光线融入场景。
description.en: A close-up that highlights material, craftsmanship or functional details; keeps the product's logo, text and shape, with light matched to the scene.

prompt.prefix: macro close-up photography highlighting fine textures and materials,
prompt.suffix: crisp focus, soft studio lighting, clean background
prompt.negative: text, watermark, product, bottle, jar, box, packaging, container, blur, noise, deformed details
